description: gen schema generates a schema whose root document declares types named after the traits the declaration macros derive (a string Hash, an enum Clone, objects Debug and Default, a union PartialEq, a map Eq) while two imported documents declare their own string, enum, and object types that reference them, so each sibling module imports every derive-named type by name beside the derives the macros expand.
